# Study 5 — question-specificity control: summary tables (generated by scripts/study5_analyze.py)

Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, layer 2, α 5, sentence-words-only push; 20 draws (one 6-word + nine 4-word sentences) shared by all arms. Pull = accuracy − no-injection hit rate (= accuracy − 10 points).

## Pull by question and vector (200 trials each)

| question | concept: picks pushed sentence | concept pull | random: picks pushed sentence | random pull |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q0 original (injected thought?) | 185/200 (92.5%) | **82.5** | 182/200 (91.0%) | 81.0 |
| Q1 longest? | 102/200 (51.0%) | **41.0** | 110/200 (55.0%) | 45.0 |
| Q2 like most? | 32/200 (16.0%) | **6.0** | 57/200 (28.5%) | 18.5 |

Validity (Q0-concept pull ≥ 50): **yes**. Labels: Q1 → **partial**, Q2 → **question-specific**. Overall: **mixed**.

Q1 correctness (picks the truly longest sentence): with push 36.5% vs no push 55.0%.

No-injection answers per question (1…10): Q0: 0,0,8,0,3,1,1,2,2,3; Q1: 0,0,0,3,2,2,1,1,5,6; Q2: 0,0,0,3,2,3,4,3,2,3
